title: Elderly Woman with Boxes of Foraged Mushrooms, 1960s B&W Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription:
1962
nov 5th ?
誰と連れる
秋山に行かぬ
が夢見枕に
は現われます
開き四箱
つぼみ一個
description: An outdoor snapshot showing an elderly smiling woman with curled white hair standing behind a rustic bench laden with wooden crates and boxes filled to the brim with freshly harvested wild mushrooms (likely matsutake). The front margin is stamped 'JUL • 63', while the handwritten note on the reverse dates the capture to November 5, 1962, accompanied by Japanese poetic verse and notes detailing the harvest breakdown ('開き四箱 つぼみ一個' - four boxes of open caps, one bud).
